process.title: Idea
process.line: We start with a real need and check it makes sense.
process.detail: Before anything is built, we look at who it is for and what they actually need. If the idea does not hold up, we do not go ahead.
process.line2: If it does not hold up, we do not build it.

process.title: Build
process.line: We build it carefully, with its own website and clear prices.
process.detail: Each business gets its own name, its own website and prices that are easy to understand. We take the time to get the details right before anything opens.
process.line2: Every detail is checked before it opens.

process.title: Launch
process.line: We open it up, check it works and fix problems fast.
process.detail: When a business opens, we test it ourselves and listen to the first people who use it. Anything that goes wrong is fixed as quickly as we can.
process.line2: Early feedback shapes what we fix and improve.

process.title: Run
process.line: We keep it running, with support and fair dealing.
process.detail: After launch, we keep looking after it and answer questions. If something goes wrong with a purchase, we put it right.
process.line2: Questions get answered and problems get put right.

standards.title: Clear
standards.detail: We say what you get and what it costs in plain words, so there are no surprises.

standards.title: Fair
standards.line: Straight dealing, and refunds when something is wrong.
standards.detail: We deal with people the way we would want to be dealt with. If something you bought is faulty or not as described, we fix it or refund you.

standards.title: Well made
standards.detail: We take care over the details and check our work before it goes out, then keep improving it.

faq.a: KB Ventures is a Melbourne company that starts and runs businesses. Each business has its own website, and all of them follow the same standard: clear, fair and well made.

faq.q: Which business should I contact about what?
faq.a: AceGuides is for study guides for Year 10 and VCE students. Black Crest Web Designs is for websites for local businesses. If you are not sure, choose General question on the contact form and we will point you the right way.
We usually reply within 2 business days. You can use the form on the contact page or email kb.ventures@outlook.com.

faq.q: What if something I bought is faulty?
faq.a: If a digital product is faulty, will not open or is not what was described, tell us and we will fix it or give you a full refund. Read the full details on the Refunds page.

faq.q: How do you use my information?
faq.a: We only collect what we need to deliver your purchase, answer your messages and keep our records. We do not sell personal information. Read the full details in our Privacy Policy.
Yes. If you would like to partner with us, tell us about it on the Partner with us page.

faq.q: How do I buy an AceGuides guide?
faq.a: Choose your guide on the AceGuides page and pay securely with Stripe. We email the guide to you after payment.

faq.q: How do I get a website made?
faq.a: Choose Black Crest Web Designs on the contact form and tell us about your business. We will reply within 2 business days to talk about it.
Sign up for updates on the home page. We will email you about new AceGuides guides and when a new business launches.
